title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Closing a Free-Time Record as Settled
content:
## What the tool does

`settle_dnd_record_d9ada3ba` closes one container's Demurrage and Detention Free Time record. It marks the free-time record settled and stamps the current day as its settlement date. It books nothing on the account, and the balance shown on the record is left exactly as it stands. Afterwards the customer sees the record as settled.

## Access

The tool is not in the agent's everyday set. The agent unlocks it and then calls it; it is a desk action, not one the customer performs.

## The single input

- `dnd_id` — the reference number of the free-time record to be closed, as the free-time record lookup gives it; plain text.

## Reply

A successful closure produces "Record <dnd_id> settled on <YYYY-MM-DD> with balance due USD <balance>.", where the date is the day of closure and the balance is the record's outstanding amount in US dollars to two decimals. A reply beginning "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was changed.

## Contract Q&A

**Q: Does closing the record write off any balance still shown?**
No. The tool changes the status and settlement date only; the balance it reports is whatever the record already shows.

**Q: Hypothetically, what does the reply look like for a record closed on 14 May with nothing owed?**
"Record <dnd_id> settled on 2026-05-14 with balance due USD 0.00." with the record's reference in place of the placeholder.
